exposure: Net2 model contents, outputs and protected observations uninspected by builder/root at registration
numeric_semantics: Canonical JSON decimal representations of finite simulator binary64 values, interpreted as exact rational decimals. No binary-float/decimal equivalence claim.
extension: Compose sample-read intervals with bounded arbitrary time-varying reference-to-sample drift; preserve shared reference error.
endpoint: Every pair distinguishable after each allowed sensor outage under the identical declared drift obligation, or return a concrete ambiguity witness.
successor_benefit_rule: At a prespecified drift level, original zero-drift plan has a reproduced unresolved pair while revised plan independently satisfies all pairs/outages. Report all drift levels; never relabel a trivial no-gap network as benefit.
comparators: reset expression and rule construction with full tools
old/new policy crossed with old/new reference-error toolbox as mechanism ablations, not generalist AI comparison
freshness: Original Net1 is development. Net2 is fresh-model transfer, with assumptions and conventional method known. Protected perturbations are engineering validation, not independent field experiments.

alpha.claim: Finite deterministic comparison; no population significance or novelty inference

funding: Research allocation only unless commerce independently qualifies unrestricted earned funds before construction; otherwise no earned-funded claim.
costs: All attempts, retrieval, adaptation, solving and checking included; parent acquisition charged once; actual model billing and enterprise expenditure remain UNKNOWN.
decision: Freeze source/protocol/checker before Net2 acquisition; hold/reject claims when criteria fail.
